title: AffineEtaleDescentData
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D : I^op → Scheme an inverse system of schemes in universe u with affine transitions and qcqs stages, and c a limiting cone with point X. Write C_i for the full affine étale site of D_i and C for that of X, with their finite standard étale precoverages [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site]. Suppose functors U_ij and v_i, natural first projections p_ij and q_i and comparison isomorphisms delta_ij are given. Suppose each p-square over D_ji and each q-square over c_i is a pullback, delta_ij.hom followed by q_i equals q_j followed by p_ij, and U_ij and v_i preserve covering presieves. Then (1) every object A of C is isomorphic to v_i(A_i) for some stage i and A_i in C_i; (2) for every finite family f_a : B_a → A in C, indexed by Fin n, its presieve covers iff there are a common stage i, objects A_i and B_ai, maps f_ai, and isomorphisms t : v_i(A_i) ≅ A and s_a : v_i(B_ai) ≅ B_a such that the stage family covers and v_i(f_ai) followed by t.hom equals s_a.hom followed by f_a. Empty families n = 0 are included. The data do not assert map descent or eventual equality.

source.place: 0EYL, proof of the qcqs case; steps 5--7 of the parent node

proof.text: Apply finite affine étale diagram descent to the empty family to obtain essential surjectivity.

For a covering family, descend its target, sources and arrows by finite diagram descent. Transport the covering backwards across the resulting isomorphisms by joint surjectivity. Apply eventual covering, then compose delta with the presentation isomorphisms. Naturality of delta proves the required conjugation equations.

Conversely apply covering preservation by v_i, rewrite map_ofArrows, and transport the jointly surjective family across the target and source isomorphisms. The Lean pointwise argument also covers n = 0.

theorem affineEtale_descent_data
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ (i : Iᵒᵖ), CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i : Iᵒᵖ), QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (U : ∀ (i j : I), i ≤ j → (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale ⥤
          (D.obj (op j)).FullAffineEtale)
      (v : ∀ i : I, (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale ⥤ c.pt.FullAffineEtale)
      (p : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j),
        U i j h ⋙ fullAffineEtaleInclusion (D.obj (op j)) ⋙
          Etale.forget (D.obj (op j)) ⋙ Over.forget (D.obj (op j)) ⟶
        fullAffineEtaleInclusion (D.obj (op i)) ⋙
          Etale.forget (D.obj (op i)) ⋙ Over.forget (D.obj (op i)))
      (q : ∀ i : I,
        v i ⋙ fullAffineEtaleInclusion c.pt ⋙ Etale.forget c.pt ⋙ Over.forget c.pt ⟶
        fullAffineEtaleInclusion (D.obj (op i)) ⋙
          Etale.forget (D.obj (op i)) ⋙ Over.forget (D.obj (op i)))
      (gamma : ∀ (i j k : I) (h : i ≤ j) (h' : j ≤ k),
        U i j h ⋙ U j k h' ≅ U i k (h.trans h'))
      (delta : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), U i j h ⋙ v j ≅ v i)
    (h1 : (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j) (A : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale),
        IsPullback ((p i j h).app A) ((U i j h).obj A).obj.hom
          A.obj.hom (D.map (homOfLE h).op)))
    (h2 : (∀ (i : I) (A : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale),
        IsPullback ((q i).app A) ((v i).obj A).obj.hom A.obj.hom (c.π.app (op i))))
    (h7 : (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j) (A : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale),
        ((delta i j h).hom.app A).hom.left ≫ (q i).app A =
          (q j).app ((U i j h).obj A) ≫ (p i j h).app A))
    (h10 : (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j) (A : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale) (R : Presieve A),
        R ∈ fullAffineEtalePrecoverage (D.obj (op i)) A →
          R.map (U i j h) ∈ fullAffineEtalePrecoverage (D.obj (op j)) ((U i j h).obj A)))
    (h12 : (∀ (i : I) (A : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale) (R : Presieve A),
        R ∈ fullAffineEtalePrecoverage (D.obj (op i)) A →
          R.map (v i) ∈ fullAffineEtalePrecoverage c.pt ((v i).obj A)))
    :
      (∀ A : c.pt.FullAffineEtale,
        ∃ (i : I) (Ai : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale), Nonempty ((v i).obj Ai ≅ A))
      ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (A : c.pt.FullAffineEtale) (B : Fin n → c.pt.FullAffineEtale)
        (f : ∀ a : Fin n, B a ⟶ A),
        Presieve.ofArrows B f ∈ fullAffineEtalePrecoverage c.pt A ↔
          ∃ (i : I) (Ai : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale)
            (Bi : Fin n → (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale) (fi : ∀ a : Fin n, Bi a ⟶ Ai)
            (t : (v i).obj Ai ≅ A) (s : ∀ a : Fin n, (v i).obj (Bi a) ≅ B a),
            Presieve.ofArrows Bi fi ∈ fullAffineEtalePrecoverage (D.obj (op i)) Ai ∧
              ∀ a : Fin n, (v i).map (fi a) ≫ t.hom = (s a).hom ≫ f a)
